title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)

messages.subject: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Price basis 2027 for part:370010 - our proposal
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your offer and your letter on the price basis.

Our orders with you for part:370010 rose from EUR 5.26 (po:4500013373-10) to EUR 5.84 (po:4500014427-10) between 2026-01-02 and 2026-09-18. That rise is already in our price.
AS-14404 fell from 3182.6744 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06) to 3007.8019 (idx:AS-14404@2026-09), a change of -5.49%.
PPI-C2431 fell from 131.9 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05) to 129.1 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08), a change of -2.12%.

You mentioned that you focus on customers with volume. Our attached packages commit our full annual volume for 24 months at a firm price, which gives you secure planning without a surcharge mechanism. Which of these packages can you sign?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Price basis 2027 for part:370010 - our proposal
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Furthermore, we have reviewed the recent index developments for AS-14404 and PPI-C2431, as well as your previous order history, and have adjusted our offer accordingly. 

Regarding our cost background, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.

While we welcome your commitment to a 24-month contract, we cannot fix the price over this period and must include an AS-14404 index clause to ensure secure planning for both sides. 

Our current proposal is a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Building on your second package, we can offer €5.30 per unit with 30 days payment terms and a 24-month contract with the AS-14404 index clause. Alternatively, with a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.30 per unit. 

Please note that this proposal stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: part:370010 - 24-month price basis with full annual volume
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for checking our data and for your revised offer.

The forecast for part:370010 increased by 1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

We would like to keep the package simple: 23,700 kg per year for 24 months at a firm price, without a surcharge mechanism. This gives you secure, plannable volume and removes the monthly surcharge administration on both sides. You mentioned that you focus on customers with volume, and this commitment covers our full annual need with you.

Can you sign the attached package? If a different contract length or payment term would help your planning, please tell us which one.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:370010 - 24-month price basis with full annual volume
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We cannot accept a fixed price for a 24-month term and must insist on the AS-14404 index clause to manage material volatility. Keeping your preferred 24-month duration and 90-day payment terms, we can reduce our price to €5.20 per unit. Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.20 per unit. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Our latest proposal is a price of €5.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Part:370010 – revised firm-price package for 24 months
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your revised offer and for checking our data.

We have moved our price in the attached package. The volume and terms are unchanged: 23,700 kg per year for 24 months, with 90 days payment. A firm price spares both sides the monthly surcharge calculation and gives you plannable, committed volume.

As this change exceeds your usual approval range, could you put the attached package to your pricing committee at its next meeting?

Can you sign the attached package?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Part:370010 – revised firm-price package for 24 months
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your revised offer; however, we cannot accept a fixed price over a 24-month period and must insist on the AS-14404 index clause. We do not require a pricing committee meeting to offer our best terms, and with the index clause included, we can reduce our price to €5.00 per unit for a 24-month contract with 90-day payment terms. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our current Angebot stands at a price of €5.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. We propose a brief meeting to discuss how the index mechanism provides secure planning for both parties. Please note that our offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
